Child and Adolescent Immunization Schedule by Age (synthetic fixture)

Synthetic fixture text. This page summarises the routine schedule for children and adolescents.

Measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine

Synthetic fixture text. Children need two doses of MMR vaccine: the first dose at 12 through 15 months of age and the second dose at 4 through 6 years of age.

Hepatitis B vaccine

Synthetic fixture text. The hepatitis B vaccine series starts at birth, with further doses at 1 through 2 months and 6 through 18 months.

VaccineAges
MMR12-15 months; 4-6 years
